Class Link

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.Link
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Link extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a single link (connector) on a side of a tile. A Link is defined by its Connectors type, which determines how it can connect with other links. It supports JSON serialization/deserialization for saving/loading tile structures.

    • isConnected

      public boolean isConnected(Link other)
      Checks if this link is compatible with another link based on connector types. Two links are considered connected if: - They have the same connector type - One is UNIVERSAL and the other is SINGLE or DOUBLE
      Parameters:
      other - the other link to check connection with
      Returns:
      true if the two links are compatible
